Description: Martha Galley and Oswald discuss a mysterious man in a photograph and how to deal with ghostly interference. Martha asks Oswald for help. After the phone rings, Oswald suggests burning the photo and other items tied to the ghosts. Thunder sounds, warning that time is running out.
Location: Kitchen（Kitchen）
Key Information:
  - No. 5 Martha Galley talks with No. 3 Oswald in the room, expressing confusion about the situation.
  - Martha says she saw an unfamiliar man in an old photograph and can’t understand these ghost phenomena.
  - Oswald warns that the ghosts may grow stronger and advises burning everything related to the ghosts.
  - Martha breaks down and begs Oswald for help, saying she’s willing to leave this home forever.
  - Martha Galley and No. 6 were in a room together just now.
  - Oswald suggests Martha take the photo upstairs and burn it to prevent things from spiraling out of control.
  - The phone rings, then thunder marks someone’s death. Oswald urges Martha to hurry.
Characters:
  [Oswald（Oswald）] Person No. 3, helps Martha understand the ghost phenomena.
    · Persuades Martha to burn ghost-related items, saying it’s the only way to stop things from escalating.
    · Offers help and stresses time is running out.
    · Warns that the ghosts are getting stronger and Martha must act quickly.
  [Martha Galley（Martha Galley）] Person No. 5, confused and collapsing under the supernatural pressure.
    · Mentions an unknown man in an old photo and says she can’t understand what’s happening.
    · Begins pleading for help and says she’ll do anything to solve it.
    · Says she’s willing to leave this home if necessary and tries to follow Oswald’s advice.
